https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The website provides automated environments for software development, enabling rapid provisioning, testing, and deployment of applications in isolated, scalable environments.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage isolated development environments for software projects.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with version control systems like Git for automated environment setup.
Users must be able to deploy applications to staging or production environments directly from the platform.
Users must have the ability to monitor resource utilization and performance metrics for each environment in real-time.
Users must be able to schedule automated testing workflows within their development environments.
Administrators must have the ability to set role-based access controls and permissions for team members.
Users must be able to clone existing environments to replicate configurations for new projects or testing scenarios.
